name: READER_FACING_INFERENCE_CLOSURE_CADENCE

generated_evidence.located_behavior: After ticket/seat/door/child evidence, neutral narration repeatedly closes the inference for the reader before the next clue or action.
The scene repeatedly converts observed evidence into explicit reader summaries such as identity/clothing implication, escape inference, and priority explanation.
Across the opening scene, questions, object evidence and character positions are repeatedly followed by clean interpretive closure before the next task.

contrastive_evidence.behavior: Political information and suspicion emerge through argument, social reaction and character-specific talk; the narration does not close every inference immediately.
Danger knowledge is mixed with dialect banter, family hierarchy, bad judgment and physical action; interpretation is not delivered as a neutral repeated summary cadence.
Action, bodily limitation and relationship history carry meaning; many implications remain embedded in what characters do rather than being restated for the reader.

boundary: Explanation itself is not the defect. Risk appears when evidence is repeatedly followed by a neutral, correct, reader-facing inference closure in a stable cadence.

name: MAXIMIZED_FUNCTIONAL_DENSITY_NO_INCIDENTAL_LIFE

generated_evidence.located_behavior: Nearly every object is immediately operational: child, ticket, seat, bag, shoe, hospital slip, handwritten warning, stranger, final instruction.
Red coat, phone, messages, missed calls, sister photo, schoolbag and umbrella form a near-continuous chain of plot-bearing evidence.
Body traits, costume, red mud, missing key, spare key and red liquid are almost exclusively clue-bearing rather than social or lived-world detail.

contrastive_evidence.anchor: 洪七公/黄蓉饮食段与曲三酒肆
contrastive_evidence.behavior: Food, jokes, historical argument and social behavior can occupy substantial space while building relationship, pleasure and character rather than immediately functioning as clues.
Meals, gambling jokes,师兄弟取笑 and mundane chores create affiliation and voice; many details are not immediately cashed out as plot evidence.
Dialect, father-son quarrel, teasing and improvised behavior coexist with danger; not every sentence exists to advance the mystery mechanically.

boundary: Do not add random filler. The supported issue is over-optimization: when almost every concrete detail immediately pays a plot/clue function, the text can feel constructed rather than inhabited.

name: UNIFORM_CLUE_INFERENCE_ACTION_CYCLE

generated_evidence.located_behavior: Question/inspection → useful clue → correct inference → next purposeful move repeats across the child, seat, bag, deck, shoe, paper and stranger sequence.
Human rejected early; the explicit countdown organizes successive clues and decisions into visibly engineered state changes.
Long-form reconstruction repeatedly packages local problem, compact answer, next constraint and next move into regular functional units.

contrastive_evidence.behavior: Scene function shifts among exposition, humor, relationship, action, cooking, reflection and surprise; cadence is not a single repeated clue-processing loop.
Banters, chores, embarrassment and exposition occupy uneven spans before plot state changes.
Threat, body, relationship and tactical choice overlap; a beat can serve several lived functions without cleanly ending in an explanatory inference.

boundary: Fast pace and frequent state change are not failures by themselves. Risk is visible repetition of the same clue→inference→action architecture.

name: CHARACTER_AS_TASK_PROCESSOR

generated_evidence.located_behavior: 周启 asks almost exclusively the right diagnostic questions, notices the plot-relevant objects and converts each answer into the next correct task.
程砚 functions primarily as a forensic inference engine: inspect, classify, ask, infer, control exit.
陈默's attention rapidly locks onto the exact plot-relevant messages, photo, schoolbag, calls and surveillance implication with little idiosyncratic cognition.

contrastive_evidence.behavior: Characters notice and respond according to temperament, relationship, appetite, loyalty and misunderstanding; useful plot cognition is filtered through personhood.

contrastive_evidence.anchor: 张小凡初入大竹峰/杜必书饭桌
contrastive_evidence.behavior: Misunderstanding names, embarrassment, jokes and social hierarchy alter what characters notice and say even when they do not advance the main plot efficiently.
Choices are constrained by old injuries, prior relationships, habit memory and physical coordination rather than only by the next plot question.

boundary: Competence is not the problem. AI-smell risk rises when the character's cognition is consistently optimized for authorial task completion rather than shaped by private priorities and imperfect attention.

name: CAUSAL_NEATNESS_AND_EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY_NARRATOR

generated_evidence.located_behavior: Narration uses clean formulations of safest action, implication and surveillance likelihood, producing an executive-summary feel.
Narrator repeatedly states what the evidence means and which priority is now most important.
Scenes frequently state relationship/goal meaning in compact correct sentences immediately after behavior.

contrastive_evidence.behavior: Even when interpretation is explicit, it is colored by slang, fear, bravado, family hierarchy and mistaken confidence rather than sounding like a neutral controller.
Narration allows jokes, embarrassment and digression to remain socially specific instead of constantly summarizing the scene's optimal meaning.

boundary: Authoritative narration exists in human novels. The supported risk is repeated neutral certainty that packages causality and priorities too cleanly across many beats.

name: LOW_SOCIAL_IDIOSYNCRASY_GENERIC_VOICE

generated_evidence.located_behavior: 周启, the child and later threat exchange mostly generic informational sentences; occupation/age/relationship produce limited distinctive syntax or conversational strategy.
班主、阿顺、程砚 primarily exchange plot information; their lines are substantially interchangeable in cadence and pragmatic directness.
Phone-message thriller mechanics dominate over character-specific speech or socially situated friction.

contrastive_evidence.behavior: Dialect, teasing, generation hierarchy, bravado and irritation make speech inseparable from who is talking.
Gambling obsession, seniority,师父脾气 and group teasing create non-interchangeable conversational strategies.
Speech carries class, temperament, appetite, irony and relationship, not just information payload.

boundary: Catchphrases and random slang are not the solution. Voice must emerge from social position, relationship and decision style.

name: ENGINEERED_REVEAL_ESCALATION

generated_evidence.located_behavior: Each solved local question is rapidly replaced by a stronger clue—ticket, empty seat, bag, shoe, bill, warning, stranger, impossible disembarkation instruction—producing a designed escalation ladder.
Messages escalate from warning to instruction to family-linked photo to surveillance image cue in a tightly controlled progression.
Explicit countdown plus successive revelations made tension strongest but triggered very early skim desire in actual-human review.

contrastive_evidence.behavior: The scene has strong escalation but is interrupted by family conflict, dialect, mistakes, crude humor and physical improvisation; escalation is not the only surface function.
Long stretches can build attachment or comedy without introducing a stronger mystery every few beats.

boundary: Cliffhangers and escalating clues are legitimate. Risk rises when escalation is too continuous, regular and visibly optimized, especially when social/lived texture is absent.

name: SHORT_SENTENCE_OR_ONE_LINE_PARAGRAPH_AS_AI_MARKER

generated_evidence.located_behavior: Frequent short standalone paragraphs occur in a human-judged AI-heavy sample.
Frequent short beats also occur in candidate variants that lost to control.

contrastive_evidence.behavior: The human-positive generated prose also uses many short action/dialogue paragraphs.
Human source prose mixes very short dialogue/action units with long paragraphs.

boundary: Do not ban short sentences or one-line paragraphs. Paragraph length is at most a contextual symptom; the stronger evidence concerns repeated functional architecture.

name: EXPLANATION_ITSELF_AS_AI_MARKER

generated_evidence.located_behavior: Explanatory and inferential sentences contribute to the heavy-AI surface when repeated after clues.
Explicit inference summaries are present.

contrastive_evidence.behavior: The source openly explains history, motive, cooking and martial context at length without thereby becoming AI prose.
The source contains long authoritative explanatory passages.

boundary: The defect is not explanation. It is repeated neutral explanation that closes reader inference on schedule and serves authorial optimization more than character/world voice.

name: CONCRETE_OBJECT_DENSITY_AS_AI_MARKER

generated_evidence.located_behavior: Many concrete objects are plot-bearing clues.
Mud, costume, keys and liquids are heavily functionalized.

contrastive_evidence.behavior: Concrete objects can be abundant and vivid while serving pleasure, culture, relationship and embodiment.

contrastive_evidence.anchor: bow, cart, wet stone, wounds, shields
contrastive_evidence.behavior: Object density is high, but objects constrain bodies and relationships rather than forming a serial clue interface.

boundary: Do not reduce concreteness. Distinguish inhabited objects from author-planted evidence tokens.
